verdict_text:
NO

The script removes head index 6 (`DROP_HEAD = 6`), but the specification requires removing head 5 ("For every layer `i`, remove head 5"). This violates the "Required result" section's item 1–3, which explicitly base the kept row/column ranges (`0..3839, 4608..6143` and `0..1279, 1536..2047`) on removing head 5, not head 6. Although the assert checks on final shapes happen to pass (removing any single head yields the same shapes), the actual values kept are wrong: the script keeps rows/columns for heads {0,1,2,3,4,5,7} instead of the required {0,1,2,3,4,6,7}, so it will fail the grader's bit-exact value comparison.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
